# Find the episode that aired immediately after "The Charity"
charity_row = df[df['Title'].str.contains('The Charity', case=False, na=False)]
charity_num = charity_row['Series #'].iloc[0]
next_row = df[df['Series #'] == charity_num + 1]
answer = next_row['Title'].iloc[0]
print(answer)

**Answer:** "The Charity" (Series #1) aired immediately before **"The Practical Joke War"** (Series #2), which aired on October 22, 1994.
